candidates.what_it_holds: Small repo (README.md, a 'code' file ~68KB, a 'tables' file ~18KB) that merges multiple national Tourism Expenditure Surveys (TES) into one panel. No commit-date/license metadata surfaced; likely academic/personal project, country/scope not confirmed from directory listing alone (would need to read the code file to identify which country's TES).

notes: This theme is a poor fit for GitHub search: WTTC, UNWTO, and BEA travel/tourism satellite account data are published almost exclusively as PDF reports and Excel/PDF tables on the organizations' own sites, and are rarely mirrored or wrapped by open-source tooling on GitHub — searches for 'WTTC', 'UNWTO tourism statistics', and 'BEA travel tourism satellite account' returned zero repos. The only hits across six gh search queries were three small/near-empty student repos (two are near-duplicate near-empty Japan TSA coursework repos with no data committed, one is a small national Tourism-Expenditure-Survey merging script of unconfirmed country scope). No repo found holds a genuine multi-year WTTC/UNWTO/BEA-TSA dataset, release asset, or a working API client for bea.gov's TSA tables. WebSearch could not be used to broaden the sweep because the session's web-search budget (200/200) was already exhausted by other concurrent agents before this scout could run any queries — recommend a follow-up scout on this theme later with a fresh WebSearch budget, focusing on: (a) bea.gov TSA API wrapper packages (BEA has a public data API covering the Travel and Tourism Satellite Account tables), (b) unwto.org/wttc.org data-portal scraper/client repos, (c) national-statistics-office TSA publications (Australia ABS TSA, Canada StatCan TSA, UK ONS TSA) which sometimes get mirrored by open-data enthusiasts more than the WTTC/UNWTO aggregates do. Also worth trying gh search with --topic=tourism-statistics or --topic=satellite-account, and code-search (once budget resets) for 'bea.gov' + 'travel and tourism' or 'TTSA' identifiers, and for national statistical office TSA release schedules (Australia, Canada, UK) which are more commonly represented in open government-data client repos than WTTC/UNWTO aggregates.
